# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1435
**GCS ObjectStore adapter: streaming/resumable upload + wire buildObjectStore (production-qualification)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** The GCS adapter buffers entire payloads into memory with io.ReadAll, causing memory spikes for large objects; buildObjectStore() lacks GCS backend wiring. -> Chunked resumable upload for objects > 5 MB with on-the-fly checksumming, plus PF_OBJECT_BACKEND=gcs integration in edpsvc.
**Success:** Objects > 5 MB upload via resumable session with bounded memory; PF_OBJECT_BACKEND=gcs initializes GCS; qualification run documented.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1435

## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=gemini-2.5-flash sha=cf50f2eb49ab)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 2 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 1 / MINOR 1 / NIT 0); dispositions: actioned 2; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MAJOR | The `Put` operation can succeed and return an `ObjectInfo` with a checksum, while the corresponding GCS object in cloud storage lacks the mandatory `pf-checksum` metadata if the final `PATCH` request fails. This violates the design invariant "Every object is hashed via SHA-256 and stamped with the `pf-checksum` metadata attribute." | ACTIONED | Enforced fail-closed return on patchMetadata error in go/gcsstore/gcsstore.go:299; verified in unit tests |
| 2 | MINOR | The `TestBuildObjectStore_GCS` test suite does not include a test case for `PF_GCS_CREDENTIALS_FILE`, leaving one authentication path for AC-2 untested. | ACTIONED | Added Case 3b testing PF_GCS_CREDENTIALS_FILE in go/edpsvc/main_test.go:670 |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  The implementation successfully delivers on AC-1, AC-2, and AC-3, providing a robust, memory-bounded streaming GCS adapter with comprehensive test coverage.
  A major integrity risk exists where the `pf-checksum` metadata might be missing from the GCS object if the final metadata patch fails, violating a core design invariant.
  Test coverage for one authentication path in `buildObjectStore` is missing.
=== 2 finding(s), 0 pending ===
